entry_points.title: Bounded HoloView capture in a headless dedicated server
entry_points.question: Can a headless Space Engineers server export a bounded camera-frame sequence with pose/tick provenance and renderer-side scene context, without native framebuffer access?
entry_points.finding: The bounded single-camera export completed and produced a tick-indexed video, hashed frames, a capture manifest, and frame-linked scene metadata from the headless server environment. This is a positive feasibility result for the specific HoloView software-renderer path.
